payload.claim: The patch built here for the wrong-version probe cell is a raw `git diff` via `git_mirror._git`, without `-c core.quotePath=false`. Every other patch fed to a critic cell in this codebase goes through `worktree.export_patch` (which always sets `core.quotePath=false` in `git_argv`), or, two functions above in this same file, `review_commit_diff` explicitly adds `-c core.quotePath=false --literal-pathspecs` with a comment noting that without it a non-ASCII path comes back octal-escaped rather than literal. A file path containing non-ASCII characters would then arrive at `_apply_criterion_probes`'s `in_touches`/`subject` check and the critic cell's patch application as an escaped string, silently mismatching `spec.touches` or failing to apply, even though the gates and fixtures here (ASCII-only paths) never exercise that case.
